title: The injector era is over. My new MSFS 2024 traffic setup (FSLTL + AIG)
description:
The "Great FSLTL Shutdown" is officially here, and for many, the sim now feels empty. But while the FSLTL injector has moved to static-only traffic, your model libraries are still the best in the business.

In this video, I’m showing you why I’ve officially retired the external injector and how I’ve "hijacked" the native Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 engine to do the work instead. By combining the FSLTL and AIG model libraries with MSFS 2024’s built-in FlightAware data, you can get moving, real-world airline traffic with 4K liveries and zero performance-heavy background apps.

The FSLTL Shutdown: Why the old way is gone and why that’s okay.
- Native data: How MSFS 2024 uses FlightAware (and the truth about the delay).
- The setup: Installing AIG AI Manager and FSLTL Base Models.
- The folder trick: How to prioritize high-quality models (PMDG, FSLTL, AIG).
- Real-Time comparison: Paris Charles de Gaulle (LFPG) test (FlightRadar24 vs. In-Sim).
